# Unsigned Saettigungssubtraktion, LSB-first. Schmale Operanden werden nullerweitert.
def SatSubRaw<p,q>(a, b):
    assert p >= 1 and q >= 1 and p <= 127 and q <= 127 and p + q <= 128
    w = p if p >= q else q
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    result = [0] * (w + 1)
    borrow = 0
    for i in range(w):
        parity = x[i] ^ y[i]
        result[i] = parity ^ borrow
        borrow = ((1 ^ x[i]) & y[i]) | ((1 ^ parity) & borrow)
    result[w] = borrow
    return pack(result)

def SatSubClamp<w>(value, flag):
    assert w >= 1 and w <= 127
    underflow = bits(flag, 1)[0]
    result = bits(value, w)
    # Bei Unterlauf werden alle Ergebnisbits 0; das Leihbit bleibt sichtbar.
    for i in range(w):
        result[i] = result[i] & (1 ^ underflow)
    return pack(result + [underflow])

def SAT_SUB<p,q>(a, b):
    assert p >= 1 and q >= 1 and p <= 127 and q <= 127 and p + q <= 128
    w = p if p >= q else q
    raw = bits(SatSubRaw<p,q>(a, b), w + 1)
    return SatSubClamp<w>(pack(raw[:w]), raw[w])

# Ergebnisports: begrenzte Differenz und underflow=1 genau bei a<b.
w = p if p >= q else q
result = bits(SAT_SUB<p,q>(a, b), w + 1)
return pack(result[:w]), result[w]
